title: p53 Orchestrates Cancer Metabolism: Unveiling Strategies to Reverse the Warburg Effect.
authors: Abukwaik, Roba; Vera-Siguenza, Elias; Tennant, Daniel; Spill, Fabian
one_liner_zh: 该文构建p53调控癌症代谢的数学模型，聚焦Warburg效应逆转，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cancer cells exhibit significant alterations in their metabolism, characterised by a reduction in oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS) and an increased reliance on glycolysis, even in the presence of oxygen. This metabolic shift, known as the Warburg effect, is pivotal in fuelling cancer's uncontrolled growth, invasion, and therapeutic resistance. While dysregulation of many genes contributes to this metabolic shift, the tumour suppressor gene p53 emerges as a master player. Yet, the molecular mechanisms remain elusive. This study introduces a comprehensive mathematical model, integrating essential p53 targets, offering insights into how p53 orchestrates its targets to redirect cancer metabolism towards an OXPHOS-dominant state. Simulation outcomes align closely with experimental data comparing glucose metabolism in colon cancer cells with wild-type and mutated p53. Additionally, our findings reveal the dynamic capability of elevated p53 activation to fully reverse the Warburg effect, highlighting the significance of its activity levels not just in triggering apoptosis (programmed cell death) post-chemotherapy but also in modifying the metabolic pathways implicated in treatment resistance. In scenarios of p53 mutations, our analysis suggests targeting glycolysis-instigating signalling pathways as an alternative strategy, whereas targeting solely synthesis of cytochrome c oxidase 2 (SCO2) does support mitochondrial respiration but may not effectively suppress the glycolysis pathway, potentially boosting the energy production and cancer cell viability.
abstract_zh: 癌细胞在代谢上表现出显著改变，其特征是氧化磷酸化（OXPHOS）减少，并即使在有氧条件下也增加对糖酵解的依赖。这种代谢转变，被称为Warburg效应，在驱动癌症不受控制的生长、侵袭和治疗耐药性中起关键作用。尽管许多基因的失调促成了这种代谢转变，但肿瘤抑制基因p53作为核心调控者脱颖而出。然而，其分子机制仍不明确。本研究引入了一个综合数学模型，整合了关键的p53靶点，提供了关于p53如何协调其靶点以将癌症代谢重定向至OXPHOS主导状态的见解。模拟结果与比较野生型和突变型p53结肠癌细胞中葡萄糖代谢的实验数据紧密吻合。此外，我们的发现揭示了p53激活水平升高能够完全逆转Warburg效应的动态能力，强调了其活性水平不仅在化疗后触发凋亡（程序性细胞死亡）中的重要性，还在于修改与治疗耐药性相关的代谢途径。在p53突变的情况下，我们的分析建议靶向糖酵解启动信号通路作为替代策略，而仅靶向细胞色素c氧化酶2合成（SCO2）虽能支持线粒体呼吸，但可能无法有效抑制糖酵解途径，从而可能增强能量产生和癌细胞存活能力。
